topic: Component layout and status flow logic
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on developing a component layout, specifically for location images and general page composition. It was suggested that the final design might involve a unified page layout with individual JSONForms placed within tabs.

A separate technical point raised concerned status management within frames. The requirement is to implement a linked dropdown menu (dropdown) that dictates possible transitions between statuses. It was determined that standard dropdown functionality, listing permissible next steps from the current status, should suffice for this feature.
decisions: The page layout may use a general composition with individual JSONForms placed in tabs.
